_read_me: Copy this file to settings.json and fill it in. settings.json is ignored by git so your token never leaves your PC.
_follow_admins: Empty means follow every admin the scribe relays. Put names in to follow only some, e.g. ["Unraveller", "Brett"].
_trim_action: ignore = hold until they say 'all out'. close = exit on their first trim. at_pct = exit the first time they trim at or above close_at_trim_pct.
